answer: Agents bond stake and evaluate an epoch-specific polynomial whose committed shares encode their rate-limit secret. Semaphore membership proofs bind messages to eligible identities, while an RLN nullifier limits each identity’s signals per epoch. Reusing a nullifier for distinct messages exposes two shares, allowing interpolation of the private key; a verifiable proof triggers immediate collateral slashing. The signal is the breach, not traffic through a jetty or inlet.
